Frequently Asked Questions

How old is De'Anthony Melton?

De'Anthony Melton is 28 years old.

Where was De'Anthony Melton born?

De'Anthony Melton was born in North Hollywood, California.

When was De'Anthony Melton born?

De'Anthony Melton was born on May 28, 1998.

How tall is De'Anthony Melton?

De'Anthony Melton is 6-2 (188 cm) tall.

How much does De'Anthony Melton weigh?

De'Anthony Melton weighs 200 lbs (90 kg).

Is De'Anthony Melton in the Hall of Fame?

De'Anthony Melton is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was De'Anthony Melton drafted?

De'Anthony Melton was drafted by Houston Rockets, 2nd round (16th pick, 46th overall), 2018 NBA Draft.

What position does De'Anthony Melton play?

Point Guard and Shooting Guard.

What is De'Anthony Melton's net worth?

De'Anthony Melton has made at least $52,896,461 playing professional basketball.

How much does De'Anthony Melton make?

De'Anthony Melton made $12,822,000 in 2025.

How many rings does De'Anthony Melton have?

De'Anthony Melton has won 0 championships.

What is De'Anthony Melton's Instagram account?

De'Anthony Melton is on Instagram at deanthonymelton.

What schools did De'Anthony Melton attend?

De'Anthony Melton attended Crespi Carmelite in Encino, California and USC.

What are De'Anthony Melton's nicknames?

Mr. Do Something is a nickname for De'Anthony Melton.
